info.name: Amazon EKS Fargate Profiles API
info.description:
Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) is a managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy to run Kubernetes on AWS without needing to install, operate, and maintain your own Kubernetes control plane or nodes.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services

item.name: Amazon EKS Describe a Fargate Profile

request.description: Returns descriptive information about an AWS Fargate profile.

item.name: Amazon EKS Delete a Fargate Profile
Amazon EKS Create a Fargate Profile

request.description: Creates an AWS Fargate profile for your Amazon EKS cluster. You must have at least one Fargate profile in a cluster to be able to run pods on Fargate.
Lists the AWS Fargate profiles associated with the specified cluster.
